items.note: Reinforces the liability shield. Template via formation service; ~1 lawyer hour to review.

items.note: Free, ~10 min at IRS.gov once the entity exists.

items.label: Registered agent
items.note: Receives legal service; also keeps Tom's home address off emails + Terms.

items.label: C-corp / Delaware conversion
items.note: DEFERRED per Tom's 2026-06-06 H1 decision. No action this quarter.

items.label: ToS v1 drafted
items.note: docs/legal/terms-of-service.md — tool-not-advisor, AI disclosure, liability cap.

items.label: Privacy Policy v1 drafted
items.note: docs/legal/privacy-policy.md — controller/processor roles, never-sell commitment.

items.label: New ToS/Privacy live on pages
items.note: Verify /terms + /privacy render v1, not old thin version (Iris's surface).

items.label: Sub-processor list completeness
items.note: Audit gap: add Anthropic, Fly, Cloudflare, Mercury, SES, PostHog, Twilio, Clerk.

items.label: Lawyer review before public reliance
items.note: ~2-3 counsel hours on ToS/Privacy/DPA; liability cap + class waiver are the priority.

items.label: Deletion timeline matches constitution (7 days)
items.note: Old policy said 30; constitution #8 says 7. Verify live page.

items.label: Data-license register in code
items.note: server/services/providers/data-licenses.ts — license + redistributable per source.

items.label: Federal sources redistributable (§105)
items.note: FEMA/USGS/USDA/USFWS/Census/BLM/EPA = public domain, redistributable.

items.label: County 'review-required' default
items.note: Live-passthrough only until a human reads each county's portal terms.

items.label: OSM ODbL attribution rendered
items.note: '© OpenStreetMap contributors' required on the map (Iris/Krieger surface).

items.label: Public-data accuracy disclosure
items.note: Add 'public records may be out of date; verify with county' near displayed values.

items.label: 'Not a broker/lender/adviser' in ToS
items.note: ToS §2/§3 state it plainly. Core legal armor.

items.label: Pax fiduciary boundary in prompts
items.note: Constitution #12; audited system prompts refer out to licensed pros.

items.label: AI disclosure at first interaction
items.note: Constitution #7 + CO SB 24-205. Verify server-side gate shipped (Iris).

items.label: 'Estimated' labels on Pax dollar figures
items.note: Revenue-impact ranges must read as estimates, not predictions (Iris/Soren).

items.label: Disclaimer coverage on every data surface
items.note: Valuation ≠ appraisal; wrong flood read = real-harm claim; FCRA on owner data.

items.label: Stripe processor (no card data stored)
items.note: Keeps AcreOS out of heavy PCI scope; Stripe handles it.

items.label: Auto-renewal clear-and-conspicuous
items.note: FTC Negative Option Rule: annual total must be equal-weight to monthly (Iris/Soren).

items.label: Easy cancellation
items.note: Constitution #4 + FTC click-to-cancel. Keep it true.

items.label: Refund policy
items.note: Terms are a Tom business decision; Beatrice drafts the language once chosen.

items.label: Dunning / failed-payment flow
items.note: Retry + notice beats silent cutoff; avoids billing disputes.

items.label: SaaS sales-tax / economic nexus
items.note: Below thresholds at Phase 0; Stripe Tax + accountant as MRR grows. MA taxes some software.

items.label: ESIGN §101(c) consent gate
items.note: Fail-closed gate + idempotency (commit 4b1a8174).

items.label: Five §101(c) disclosures present
items.note: Verify EsignConsentDialog has all five verbatim (Iris).

items.label: Audit trail (IP, UA, timestamp)
items.note: signing_consent_audit captures attributability.

items.label: 7-year retention of signing records
items.note: Matches contract statute of limitations; verify retention policy.

sections.title: 7. Customer data: security, breach, deletion, DPA

items.label: DPA drafted
items.note: docs/legal/data-processing-agreement.md — processor terms; B2B sales unblocker.

items.label: Security posture documented
items.note: 'Reasonable security' standard; honest controls, no certs we don't have.

items.label: 50-state breach-notification readiness
items.note: All 50 states have laws. Need a one-page incident runbook BEFORE an incident.

items.label: GDPR 72-hour breach notification stated
items.note: Verify v1 Privacy doc includes Art. 33 commitment.

items.label: 7-day deletion (constitutional)
items.note: Constitution #8; /founder/dsar + legal-holds operate it.

items.label: Tech E&O / Professional Liability
items.note: Most relevant for a data+AI product; covers cost of defending a 'your data cost me' claim.

items.label: Cyber liability
items.note: Breach-response + a lawyer on call. Pairs with the breach runbook.

items.label: General liability (CGL)
items.note: Lower priority for pure software; often bundled cheaply in a tech BOP.

items.label: MA breach law (93H) readiness
items.note: Notice to residents + MA AG + Consumer Affairs. Folds into the breach runbook.

items.label: MA WISP (201 CMR 17.00)
items.note: MA uniquely requires a Written Information Security Program for holding MA residents' PI.

items.label: MA SaaS sales-tax treatment
items.note: MA taxes prewritten software; SaaS is fact-specific — accountant question.

items.label: Foreign-entity registration in MA
items.note: If formed outside MA but operated from MA. Moot if formed in MA.
